_readme: Template for BOTH parties' consent in a real bilateral dispute fixture. Sections A and B are the legally meaningful records; section C shows the exact wire format the DDE engine verifies (E5 CONSENT_BINDING). Fill every field, sign the digests off-platform with each party's own key, and never paste private keys anywhere. Nothing in this template is legal advice — parties should have their own counsel review the underlying agreement and the scope of disclosure.

A_redactionGrants._who: PARTY A — fill for the first party (e.g. the client/principal)
A_redactionGrants.grantorAddress: 0x… (party A's own wallet address; E5 replays the signature to this exact address)
A_redactionGrants.fixtureRef: 0x… (32-byte hex — computed in step 2 of the procedure; both parties MUST sign the same value)
A_redactionGrants.scope: Redacted public review of this fixture: agreed scope: [what reviewers may see, e.g. the ten DDE records and their hashes]; excluded: [anything withheld]; duration: [e.g. until 2027-01-01 UTC]; revocation: [how either party withdraws consent].

signature.digest: 0x… (EIP-712 digest of grantor/fixtureRef/scope below domain 'CoreGuard DDE Redaction Grant' v1 chainId 1116 — sign off-platform, or via tools/e2e-sign)

A_redactionGrants._who: PARTY B — same fields, party B's own key and address
A_redactionGrants.fixtureRef: 0x… (identical to party A's — one fixture, one reference)

B_disclosureConsent.attribution: How each party wishes to be named, or 'anonymous party A/B'

C_recordClosureConsent.closureEffect: After closure no party may edit their submitted records; further submissions require a new fixture.
C_recordClosureConsent.remedyAgreed: NONE | REWORK | PARTIAL_REFUND | FULL_REFUND | CREDIT — the closed remedy vocabulary; anything outside it is rejected by the engine (B3)

D_declarations.noCoercion: Both parties confirm consent was given freely.
D_declarations.perjuryAwareness: Both parties confirm the statements above are accurate to the best of their knowledge.
